svg.title: Free Trader Plus - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 86-87, PDF 87-88. Single-deck full silhouette preserves flat narrow forward bridge, long tapered fuselage and rounded concave transitions into broad square aft machinery shoulders. Illustration corroborates wider Type A-derived stern. Rear cargo opening remains solid top projection; interiors, crane and fuel partitions excluded.
